the heights are compared only afterwards."""305    ts = np.arange(lo, hi + 1e-9, step); v = np.asarray(count_fn(ts), float)306    out = []307    for i in range(len(ts) - 1):308        for h in np.arange(math.floor(min(v[i], v[i + 1])) + 0.5, max(v[i], v[i + 1]), 1.0):309            if (v[i] - h) * (v[i + 1] - h) < 0:310                out.append((float(h), float(ts[i]), float(ts[i + 1]), int(np.sign(v[i + 1] - v[i]))))311    return out312313def secular_roots_scan(comb, lo, hi, const=1.0, theta_fn=theta, corrected=False, step=0.1):314    """The secular roots on [lo, hi] with brackets from the count itself (Obs. trace): every upward half-integer315    crossing refined by Brent's method. its half-integer1061#                           crossings, bracketed by the count alone, recover the fifteen heights with the1062#                           N = 10⁶ comb to mean error 8.0×10⁻⁵ (max 2.0×10⁻⁴), L never evaluated (ledger E16)10631064HEIGHTS_CHI_STATED = [6.0209, 10.2438, 12.9881, 16.3426, 18.2920, 21.4506]1065NCHI_STATED = [0.4997, 1.4998, 2.4999, 3.4999, 4.4999, 5.4998]10661067def chi4(n):1068    """χ_{−4}(n): 0 on even n, +1 on n ≡ 1, −1 on n ≡ 3 (mod 4)."""1069    n = np.asarray(n)1070    return np.where(n % 2 == 0, 0.0, np.where(n % 4 == 1, 1.0, -1.0))10711072def twisted_support(N):1073    """(n, χ(n)Λ(n)) on the prime powers ≤ N with χ(n) ≠ 0."""1074    n, lam = von_mangoldt_support(N)1075    c = chi4(n.astype(np.int64))1076    keep = c != 01077    return n[keep], (c * lam)[keep]10781079def theta_chi(T):1080    T = np.asarray(T, float)1081    return np.imag(loggamma(0.75 + 0.5j * T)) + 0.5 * T * math.log(4 / math.pi)10821083def Lambda_chi_line(t):1084    """Completed Λ(½ + it, χ_{−4}) = (4/π)^{(s+1)/2} Γ((s+1)/2) L(s, χ); mean error {err.mean():.2e}, max {err.max():.2e}", kind="[approx]")1117    _C_chi_complex()11181119# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- C7c: the complex character mod 51120CHI5 = np.array([0, 1, 1j, -1j, -1], dtype=complex)        # χ(n) by n mod 5: χ(1)=1, χ(2)=i, χ(3)=−i, χ(4)=−11121MP_CHI5 = {1: mp.mpc(1), 2: mp.mpc(0, 1), 3: mp.mpc(0, -1), 4: mp.mpc(-1)}11221123class ComplexTwistedComb:1124    """The χ-weighted tapered comb for a complex character: Σ^χ_w(½ + iT) = Σ_{n≤N} χ(n)Λ(n) w(n) n^{−½−iT}/log n, and1125    S(T) = (1/π) Im[Σ^χ_w(½+iT) − Σ^χ_w(½)] — the comb side of the twisted count, the difference from height 01126    removing the constant of the complex case (Obs. chi). Exposes N and S(T) so that the scan of the shared primitives applies."""1127    def __init__(self, N, chi_table):1128        self.N = int(N)1129        n, lam = von_mangoldt_support(self.N)1130        logn = np.log(n);
